patch_description:
This candidate reduces parameter count and enforces a strong, geometry-aligned inductive bias to improve generalization and parameter efficiency.

Design choices:
- Replace many parametrized two-qubit CRZs with fixed CZ entangling edges to keep entanglement expressive while removing tunable two-qubit parameters (reduces N_PARAMS).
- Preserve symmetry grouping: corners, edges, center share RY/RZ parameters to capture geometric invariances with few parameters.
- Introduce explicit three-qubit ZZZ motifs on every winning line. Rows/columns share one parameter (zzz_line) while the two diagonals share a second (zzz_diag). This targets the game's triple correlations directly and compactly.
- Add a single RX on the center qubit to give extra flexibility for the draw-class observable without proliferating parameters.
- The resulting block is shallower in parameter space (fewer unique parameters per block), improving parameter efficiency and reducing overfitting risk while preserving rich entangling structure via CZ + ZZZ motifs.

Expected outcome:
- Fewer total trainable parameters (54 vs 78 previously) -> better parameter efficiency.
- Explicit winning-line ZZZ motifs to improve accuracy on line-detection tasks.
- Fixed CZ backbone maintains entangling depth but reduces parameter search complexity, helping validation/test accuracy and reducing train-test gap.

The rest of the program is unchanged; only the ANSATZ_SPEC inside the EVOLVE-BLOCK is modified.
